headline: Ship it
body: Ship it, then prove it. What goes out today?

headline: Cluster warm
body: The cluster is warm. Point it at something worth the tokens.

headline: Unstick it
body: Bring the app that is stuck in review. We will get it moving.

headline: Short version
body: On shift or off, give me the short version.

headline: Pick one
body: Markets or the build first? Pick one.

headline: One proof
body: One task, one owner, one proof. What is it?

headline: Where first
body: Protocol Guide, the Deck, or the fleet. Where do we start?

headline: Hand it over
body: Send the crash, the log, or the half-built idea. I'll take it from there.

headline: Clear the list
body: Crew first, family next, code after. What can I take off the list?

headline: Local
body: Everything here runs on your own machines. Ask freely.

headline: Verify
body: Plan less, verify more. What needs checking?

headline: Own it
body: Name the thing that keeps slipping. I'll own it until it ships.

headline: Fleet up
body: Fleet is up. Pick a host, a repo, or a problem.

headline: The board
body: Charts, comps, or code. What's on the board?

headline: Long shift
body: Long shift? Hand me the backlog and go rest.

headline: The job
body: No pitch, no fluff. Tell me the job.

headline: Swell later
body: Swell check later. Ship something first.

headline: Benchmark
body: Benchmark it or it didn't happen. What are we testing?

headline: Screenshot
body: Drop the screenshot. I'll turn it into a task.

headline: Size it
body: Size the trade before the story. What are you looking at?

headline: Teach it
body: Build it once, teach it to the crew for good. What's the lesson today?

headline: Recall
body: The vault remembers so you don't have to. What do you need back?

headline: Answer first
body: Short answer first, details if you want them. Go.

headline: Start there
body: Something on fire, literally or otherwise? Start there.
